mutations.name: a replot's points are not compared with the figure's data
mutations.find: a.every((p, i) => p.x === b[i]!.x && p.y === b[i]!.y)
kills: paper publish eligibility fails a replot whose points are not the figure's data

mutations.name: a replot may drop points
kills: paper publish eligibility fails a replot that drops a point, and a replot with no series

mutations.name: a replot with no series passes
kills: paper publish eligibility fails a replot that drops a point, and a replot with no series

mutations.name: a replot need not cite a gathered figure
mutations.find: if (!fact) return `replot ${beat.id} cites no gathered figure; its source.ref must name a figure fact id`;
kills: paper publish eligibility fails a replot citing a source that is not a gathered figure
